name: Call Disposition
job: Single call-disposition graph keyed on channel (not clinic). Native update-in-place; never remove-and-recreate. No Sales opp create. No attribution write.

trigger.notes: One graph total; do not fork per clinic. Transactional; no quiet hours. Curve owns attribution; do not write utm/gclid/fbc/fbp anywhere here.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Call Status changed (channel=phone)
named_steps.comment: Sole call-dispo entry. Do not fork per clinic slug.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_source_phone
named_steps.comment: New v2 phone-source tag on any call event.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.last_call_disposition (native update-in-place)
named_steps.comment: Native field update. Never delete-and-recreate the contact or opp. No Sales opp create.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on call outcome (connected | voicemail | missed | wrong-number)
named_steps.comment: Single graph. Curve owns attribution; must not write utm/gclid/fbc/fbp.

named_steps.name: SMS: Voicemail follow-up (inline, voicemail branch, first in this sequence)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Transactional; no quiet hours.

named_steps.name: SMS: Missed follow-up (inline, missed branch, first in this sequence)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Transactional; no quiet hours.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_bad_number (wrong-number branch)
named_steps.comment: Signals compliance semantics; WF-11 still owns the field-level write.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route wrong-number to WF-11 Compliance
named_steps.comment: WF-11 owns DND and bad-number field writes.
